$comment: Single source of truth for environment variables across the monorepo. Defaults below are LOCAL DEV values. Production overrides are gathered interactively by setup.sh when run with --prod (or via BACKEND_URL / FRONTEND_URL env vars). Edit this file when you add a new env var to any Zod schema or t3-env config, then run `bash setup.sh`. The drift checker (`pnpm check:env`) verifies this file matches the schemas in code.

NODE_ENV.comment: development | production | test. Forced to production by setup.sh --prod.

BASE_URL.comment: API origin (no /api or /trpc suffix). In prod, set to backend URL.

CORS_ORIGIN.comment: Comma-separated allowed origins for credentialed CORS. In prod, set to frontend URL.

DATABASE_URL.comment: Postgres connection string. Stays local-first; override per-environment after setup if needed.

JWT_SECRET.comment: JWT signing key. Auto-generated on first setup. Must be >= 32 chars in production.

RATE_LIMIT_SUBMISSION_PER_MIN.comment: Per-IP submission start/complete cap, per 60s window

LOGGER_LEVEL.comment: error | warn | info | debug. setup.sh --prod forces 'info'.

NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.comment: tRPC endpoint URL (includes /trpc suffix). Derived from backend URL in prod.

NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_ORIGIN.comment: Public web origin. In prod, set to frontend URL.
